get.description: Retrieve a list of videos from your library

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Filters by keyword, title, source id, id, zobject title

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter by active, inactive, or all.  If excluded, query will default to 'true'

parameters.name: on_air
parameters.description: Filter records that are either on or off air

parameters.name: live_event
parameters.description: Filter records that are live events

parameters.name: video_source_type
parameters.description: Filter records by video source type. Multiple types can be provided by passing a comma-separated list. Examples: `zype`, `hulu`, `youtube`, `crunchyroll`

parameters.name: parental_guidelines_rating
parameters.description: Parental guidance rating of the video

parameters.name: dpt
parameters.description: Filter records by Dynamic Player Technology conditions (Geo-location and device restrictions). If set to `true` this will return videos that are playable from your location/device.

parameters.name: created_at
parameters.description: Filter records by created date using times in ISO8601 format (Example: `2017-01-01T00:00:00-00:00`) or Unix timestamps (Example: `1483228800`) **Note**: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: `created_at.gte`)

parameters.name: published_at
parameters.description:
Filter records by published date using times in ISO8601 format Example: `2017-01-01T00:00:00-00:00` or Unix timestamps `1483228800`.
Note: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: `.gt`, `.gte`, `.lt`, `.lte` Example: `published_at.gte=2017-01-01T00:00:00-00:00`

parameters.name: category
parameters.description:
Filter records that match all category values listed.
Example: `category[genre][]=comedy&category[language][]=english` Matches all playlists having ALL of the category name/value pairs listed.

parameters.name: category_or
parameters.description:
Filter records that match any category values listed.
Example: `category_or[genre][]=comedy&category_or[language][]=english` Matches all playlists that have ANY of the category name/value pairs listed.

parameters.name: category_and
parameters.description:
